text.p: Cartaway Resources Corp said on Wednesday it has signed deals for an interest in two Labrador properties.
The properties are in the Okak Bay area near Cartaway's Cirque exploration property, the company said in a statement.
Cartaway said it has signed a deal with International CanAlaska Resources Ltd and International Freegold Mineral Development Inc to earn a 60 percent interest in an area comtaining 80 claim units.
Under the deal, Cartaway must issue 100,000 shares to the vendors and spend C$3 million by September 1, 1999.
In the second agreement, Cartaway can earn a 60 percent interest in 79 claim units owned by Ace Development Ltd.
Cartaway said it must issue a total of 168,750 shares before June 2, 1997 and, if warranted, provide sufficient funding to bring the property to a production decision.
